summary: Føroya Banki, together with its subsidiaries, provides personal and corporate banking services in the Faroe Islands and Greenland. It operates through Banking and Non-Life Insurance segments. The company provides non-life insurance products, such as property and casualty insurance; life, disability, and critical illness insurance; and real estate agency services. It also offers car loans, mortgage financing, debit and credit cards, pensions, as well as online banking services. The company was formerly known as P/F BankNordik and changed its name to Føroya Banki in March 2024. Føroya Banki was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Tórshavn, Denmark.
